name: Google Professional Cloud Architect

D1.name: Designing and planning a cloud solution architecture

D4.name: Analyzing and optimizing technical and business processes

realExamNote: The real exam has 50–60 questions in 2 hours, and 20–30% of them are based on two of four published case studies (Altostrat Media, Cymbal Retail, EHR Healthcare, KnightMotives Automotive).
scoreNote: Google doesn't publish a passing score, so 70% is used here as a readiness target.
